dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sometimes I think that way too.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Haha, you're in the right place, then! This is where treasure hunters gather. You'll never find a place with more interesting experiences amongst its clientele.

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: Of course, if you want to say bye-bye to a boring life, the only way is to become a treasure hunter!

dialogues.speaker: Suronja
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I had an in of some kind...
